profiles.tradeoff: Bomb uses are halved and the extra power of primal reagents often depends on random outcomes.

They learn methods of combining weapon attacks with their alchemical magic, and sacrifice skill with poisons in order to become more adept at using alchemical bombs or using alchemical items in conjunction with their martial skills.
profiles.tradeoff: This Monster Codex version similarly sacrifices potion and poison features for martial weapon and bomb delivery.

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The archetype explicitly specialises in disabling traps and deploying mines.

evidence.reason: Trapfinding / Explosive Disarm / Land Mine materially changes battlefield control compared with the base Alchemist.
Trapfinding / Explosive Disarm / Land Mine materially changes stealth subterfuge compared with the base Alchemist.

profiles.playerSummary: Trap breakers forgo the study of poison to instead master the construction and deployment of traps, using their nimble fingers to disable dangerous devices and their alchemical knowledge to create devastating land mines.
profiles.tradeoff: All major poison features are exchanged for traps and land mines that reward preparation and positioning.

profiles.name: Vaultbreaker

professionIdentity.evidenceText: The archetype explicitly specialises in defeating locks, hinges and vault mechanisms.

evidence.reason: Breaking and Entering / Safecracking materially changes area multi target damage compared with the base Alchemist.
Breaking and Entering / Safecracking materially changes stealth subterfuge compared with the base Alchemist.

profiles.playerSummary: The vaultbreaker combines stealth with his bomb-making talents to construct special focused charges that can disable or destroy hinges, locks, and similar mechanisms.
profiles.tradeoff: Ordinary bombs, Throw Anything and potion brewing become focused breaching charges and rogue-like infiltration tools.

profiles.name: Vivisectionist

evidence.reason: Sneak Attack materially changes melee combat compared with the base Alchemist.
Sneak Attack materially changes area multi target damage compared with the base Alchemist.
Sneak Attack materially changes stealth subterfuge compared with the base Alchemist.

profiles.playerSummary: A surgical Alchemist who abandons bombs for full sneak attack, anatomical expertise and disturbing transformations.
profiles.tradeoff: Reliable area damage disappears and the strongest offence depends on qualifying for sneak attack.

profiles.name: Wasteland Blightbreaker

evidence.reason: Healing Infusion / Banish Blights materially changes healing recovery compared with the base Alchemist.
Healing Infusion / Banish Blights materially changes anti magic disruption compared with the base Alchemist.

profiles.playerSummary: The deleterious effects of the weird hazards of the Mana Wastes require special skill to remedy.
profiles.tradeoff: Poison defences and discoveries are exchanged for curatives and narrowly focused removal of magical afflictions.

profiles.name: Winged Marauder

constraints.summary: This archetype is available only to goblin characters.

evidence.reason: Flying Beast Tamer / Sipping Pet materially changes summoning companions compared with the base Alchemist.
Flying Beast Tamer / Sipping Pet materially changes combat mobility compared with the base Alchemist.

profiles.playerSummary: Goblin alchemists have created a mixture of pheromones that they use to manipulate and entice giant vultures or dire bats to do their bidding.
profiles.tradeoff: Mutagen and related discoveries are lost, and the defining mobility depends on keeping a giant vulture or dire bat alive.
